description: Eastern Province - Appocinted Hon. Ahamed Nazeer Zainulabdeen as Chief Minister and the Provincial Minister for Finance and Planning etc; Hon. Ibrahim Mohamed Mohamed Mansoor as the Provincial Minister for Health etc; Hon. Kirushnapillai Thurairasasingam as the Provincial Minister for Agriculture etc; Hon. Singaravelu Thandauthayapani as the Provincial Minister for Education etc; Hon. Ariyawathy Galappaththy as the Provincial Minister for Road Development etc w.e.f. 03.03.2015
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (Hon. Ahamed Nazeer Zainulabdeen, Hon. Ibrahim Mohamed Mohamed Mansoor, etc.) AND detailed portfolio responsibilities for each appointment (e.g., "Chief Minister and the Provincial Minister for Finance and Planning, Law and Order, Local Government...", "Provincial Minister for Health, Indigenous Medicine, Probation and Childcare..."). This combination of people names and detailed ministerial portfolio descriptions meets the criteria for Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
